Package com.sca4d.web.realtime.config

Class WebRealtimeProperties

java.lang.Object
com.sca4d.web.realtime.config.WebRealtimeProperties
@ConfigurationProperties("sca4dj.web-realtime") public final class WebRealtimeProperties extends Object
配置 Web Realtime 节点传输、租约、SSE、WebSocket 票据、帧限制和 Origin。
